notes.title: Development Blog: First contact.
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello explorers![/b][/p][p]Mars Clicker is finally starting to take shape! [/p][p]What you see in the images below are the initial phase of the colony on Mars and a first approximation of what the final phase will be like, I keep making modifications every time I add new buildings so I don't think it's the final part.    [/p][p][/p][p]So far I have been working mainly with numbers, so the game will support big numbers and all those who are ready to bust the game will have a good time.[/p][p][/p][p]I still have to confirm the UI, for now I have such a basic one that it's not even worth sharing but soon I will update and you will also see some gameplay, probably on the youtube channel.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45237091/a5848fa473d1f3ecc320899d1ff3fcbcd7d7a81c.png"][/img][/p][p]I've had time to refine the collection of crystals and their conversion to dark matter, although I'm still working on the meta-progress of the game, I'll give more details.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45237091/15f0b50b23cef8147953e3e977ddd2289ba30d7b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Development Blog: Event Horizon Devlog
notes.notes:
Hello explorers!

This new adventure begins. I was really looking forward to update you on the development status of Mars Clicker. That's why I recently made a video for the youtube channel.

[previewyoutube=X9PuDXSJXZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

Development has been delayed a bit by all the work it has taken to bring Space Battle to Nintendo Switch. Fortunately, everything is on track and we can only look forward.
